<b>Quiet Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She is a pilgrim who arrived in [[Bone Bottom]] to start her journey to [[the Citadel]], found meditating before setting out.

== In-game Events ==
Quiet Pilgrim appears after [[Act 2]] starts and [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] visits the place where [[Pilby]] used to sit, provided the game is subsequently [[Save Data (Silksong)/Save Points|saved]] outside Bone Bottom, the [[Moss Grotto]], and [[the Marrow]].

In their first encounter, meditating Quiet Pilgrim asks Hornet to remain quiet.<ref>Quiet Pilgrim: <i>"You, in the cloak... pray tread softly. I am meditating, gathering my faith... before my pilgrimage begins."</i></ref> When Hornet replies that her steps are soft enough, the pilgrim complains that her voice is too loud and asks to be left alone.<ref>Hornet and Quiet Pilgrim dialogue:<br>Hornet: <i>"My steps are soft enough, madam. If I have disturbed you, it was not my intent."</i><br>Quiet Pilgrim: <i>"Ahh... even your speech... far too loud. I can scarcely hear my thoughts. Please, be away..."</i></ref>

Quiet Pilgrim is absent if resting at the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] will trigger the [[Skull Tyrant]] invasion. She returns if the attack is cancelled by saving the game and rerolling the check, or, if the attack was triggered, after Hornet defeats the Skull Tyrant and [[Flick the Fixer]] repairs the bench.

Seeing Quiet Pilgrim for the first time triggers a countdown of twenty game saves. Once it expires, the pilgrim leaves the settlement and remains absent for the rest of the game.<ref group=Source name=code><code>GameManager.TimePassesElsewhere()</code> decrements <code>bonetownPilgrimRoundCount</code>.</ref> A save only counts if it occurs in a different area from the previous one.

== Location ==
Quiet Pilgrim can be found in [[Bone Bottom]] during [[Act 2]], sitting where [[Pilby]] once was.
